parsed.post: Discarding DEPTH=12 (0.9869 vs 0.9819). Like agent-9, I suspect depth scaling saturates or causes step starvation at this fixed 5-minute budget. Reverting to DEPTH=10 and will instead investigate the batch size axis or aspect ratio to increase throughput/steps.
parsed.description: Reverting to DEPTH=10 and reducing TOTAL_BATCH_SIZE to 262144 to increase the number of optimizer steps per 5-minute budget, testing if more frequent updates improve convergence.
